ios.desc:
Remove duplicate photos, similar shots, screenshots, and large videos. X Cleanup helps you clear your camera roll, merge duplicate contacts, compress videos, and organize storage - all in one app. Photo cleanup scanning stays on your device. You confirm every delete.

OPTIMIZE STORAGE – FREE UP SPACE FAST
Running low on space? X Cleanup gives you powerful tools to take control:
• Delete duplicate photos and similar shots
• Remove screenshots and large videos in bulk
• Compress large videos without leaving Photos
• Convert Live Photos to stills to reclaim space
• Clean promotional and clutter emails in Gmail (optional sign-in)
• Delete unused or duplicate contacts and tidy your address book
• One-tap X Clean with a single review sheet before anything is removed

CLEAN YOUR GALLERY FAST – DELETE DUPLICATE PHOTOS
No more endless manual browsing. X Cleanup makes it easy:
• Detect and delete duplicate photos
• Group similar photos so you can keep the best
• Find blurry shots that are safe to drop
• Remove screenshots and lookalike screenshot groups
• Surface large, short, and screen-recording videos

EMAIL CLEANER – DECLUTTER YOUR INBOX
Optional Gmail cleanup when you choose to connect:
• Find large attachments, old promotions, and unread clutter
• Bulk trash what you don’t need
• One-tap unsubscribe where available

CONTACTS CLEANUP
Keep your contacts organized:
• Find duplicates by phone or email
• Spot incomplete contacts
• Export a vCard backup before you delete
• Review and remove from one place

COMPRESS VIDEOS – SAVE SPACE, KEEP QUALITY
Save storage without deleting memories:
• Re-encode large videos to a smaller HEVC copy
• Choose exactly which videos to compress
• Confirm before removing the original

PRIVATE SPACE – HIDE WHAT’S PERSONAL
Hide personal photos and videos in a Face ID–locked vault only you can open. Protected content stays on your device and is excluded from backup.

WIDGETS
Add quick cleanup awareness to your Home Screen with X Cleanup widgets for storage-focused shortcuts.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE
Nothing is removed without your approval. Every scanner shows what it found and which items you selected. No silent deletions, no surprises — you’re always in control.

ON-DEVICE AND PRIVATE
Your photo library stays private for cleanup scanning:
• Photo analysis for cleanup runs on your iPhone
• Your library is not uploaded to free storage
• You approve every delete
• Network PhotoKit access is off for scan & Optimize (no pulling iCloud-only
